b6_reason: H2O boils highest (373 K) because of hydrogen bonding, so the stated order is wrong, and for that same reason the boiling points of this set do not simply increase with molar mass.
b6_working: Boiling points: H2S 213 K < H2Se 232 K < H2Te 271 K < H2O 373 K; correct order is H2S < H2Se < H2Te < H2O.
b6_note: Statement II is true for H2S, H2Se and H2Te alone; it fails for the set as a whole because of H2O, which is why both statements are taken as incorrect. If II were graded as correct in isolation, option 4 would be the alternative.
